criminal_detail: Skinnider was criminally investigated after the woman's 2009 complaint, but the Crown did not recommend charges and none were laid. The matter was handled through the police disciplinary process, in which he was found guilty of discreditable conduct and received sanctions. A separate 2020 RCMP investigation into an unrelated viral-video incident also ended without charges.
description: A woman filed a civil lawsuit in January 2021 against Saskatoon Police Service constable Patrick Skinnider over events in February 2009. According to the statement of claim, Skinnider came to her home while investigating her domestic-violence complaint, kissed her without consent, and the next day forced her into sex, abusing his position of authority; the suit alleges he then manipulated her into a continuing sexual relationship. In his February 2021 statement of defence, Skinnider claims the relationship was consensual at all times. Following the woman's 2009 complaint to police, Skinnider was found guilty of discreditable conduct under Saskatchewan's police disciplinary process and received sanctions, but no criminal charges were laid. Dedicated searches found no public reporting on how the civil suit was resolved.
